description: This is a shell script designed to set up build environment for a software project; it manages dependencies, generates Makefiles via CMake, and builds components such as third-party dependencies and core code.

methods.name: showUsage
methods.description: Prints usage information for the script.

methods.name: showHeader
methods.description: Displays a banner or header message.

methods.name: checkTools
methods.description: Verifies presence of required tools: cmake, gcc, java 1.8.

methods.name: checkThirdParty
methods.description: Checks if third-party dependencies are built for the target platform.

methods.name: checkTargetPlatform
methods.description: Determines if build target and cross output variables are set.

methods.name: runBuildThirdParty
methods.description: Builds third-party dependencies, including generating Makefiles and compiling.

methods.name: runCreateMakefiles
methods.description: Generates Makefiles for the specified build model without building.

methods.name: runBuildCore
methods.description: Builds the main core of the project, including unit tests and coverage if applicable.
